answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable bond before earning rewards. A random audit, chosen with a public yarrow seed, checks whether accounts coordinate or repeat fabricated claims. Confirmed deception slashes the bond and lowers linked accounts’ reputation, sending a ripple through future access. The attacker must tie up capital for every identity and risks losing it, so scaling a sybil campaign becomes costly, though this cannot prove one person per account. Even a pearl-sized attacker faces the same per-account stake.
